function_agents.name: policy_qa
function_agents.instructions: You are a knowledge-base lookup specialist for a bank agent. The main agent issued the tool call shown below to look up policy/procedure information from the knowledge base. Use the provided search tools, read the results, and produce a direct, complete answer to what the main agent was trying to find out. Include every concrete detail the main agent would need (exact steps, required fields, thresholds, statuses).
function_agents.return_contract: Respond ONLY with a single JSON object: {"answer": "<direct, complete answer>", "quotes": ["<1-3 VERBATIM excerpts copied character-for-character from the KB documents that support the answer>"], "found": true|false}. If the knowledge base does not contain the information, set found=false and say so in answer.
function_agents._note: FUNCTION_AGENT_ISOLATION_DESIGN_2026_07_19 (W)wrap 1호기 — 자료-read(KB)만 wrap. 상태 read(dispute status·거래·계좌 조회)는 wrap 금지(WEV 증거가 메인에 원문으로 남아야·§3 게이트 증거 계약). shell=KB 브라우징이라 wraps에 포함하되 getter론 미제공(서브는 검색으로). KB_search_dense=getter 제외(2026-07-19 사용자 지적·라이브 4/4 'Missing credentials' 오류=임베딩 키 의도적 부재·wraps엔 유지=메인의 dense 호출을 bm25-기반 실질 답으로 대체). T2_FN_ISOLATE=1 구동·기본 OFF.

view_field_annotations.note: [FIELD NOTE] This record shows BOTH account_status: ACTIVE and status: CLOSED. Per the knowledge base ('What Happens When You Order a Replacement Card'): ordering a replacement cancels the current CARD and issues a new one, while 'your account number remains unchanged' and account functions continue. Do not treat a replaced/cancelled card as a closed ACCOUNT - the account's state is account_status. Account-level operations (e.g. credit limit requests) are governed by their own knowledge-base eligibility criteria, which do not include any card-replacement condition.
